<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin 4''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４を占領していると、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、ヤヴィンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４を占領していると、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、ヤヴィンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-135o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin 4.

'''Light Side:''' If you occupy Yavin 4, add 1 to total power in battles at Yavin sites for each of your starships here.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy Yavin 4, add 1 to total power in battles at Yavin sites for each of your starships here.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses occupy and Yavin sites; English uses control and Yavin 4 sites.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin 4]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
